resources.string: All current features are available in this build. Purchases are not available yet. Your history stays on this device unless you export it or turn on Google Drive backup. Optional barcode lookup uses Open Food Facts after you agree to it.
Saves your history every day to a private folder in your own Google Drive. Only this app can open it.
